description: Set gain (number, ramped) or mute (boolean) on selected mixer cues (Mixer.SetCue{Gain,Mute}). This MUTATES the running/emulated system. Read mixer state back via qsys_get_component.

cues.description: Cue selector (string specification of mixer cues)

ramp.description: Ramp time in seconds — gain only, ignored otherwise

value.description: Number (dB) for gain; boolean for mute

name: qsys_mixer_set_cue
title: Set mixer cue(s)
